Frontend shows personalization in most places except DailyTasks section title which shows generic 'Heute fuer dich wichtig' instead of 'Heute fuer Max wichtig'. rca_of_the_issue: The DailyTasks section title bug appears to be a React state timing/re-render issue. The firstName state is set from API response (confirmed via network interception: first_name='Max'), and task.title is correctly personalized. However, the section title Text component at line 162-166 renders with firstName=null and doesn't re-render when state updates. This could be due to React Native's Text component optimization or a closure issue with the useState hook.
